name: Formera
author: Nischal Acharya

sections.description:
Formera is a powerful and intuitive survey builder plugin for WordPress. Create beautiful surveys with ease using our modern, user-friendly interface.

Features:

  • Easy-to-use survey builder
  • Multiple question types
  • Response tracking and analytics
  • Email outreach capabilities
  • GDPR compliant
  • Customizable branding
  • Responsive design
sections.installation:
1. Upload the formera folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘Formera’ in your admin menu to create your first survey
  4. Use the shortcode [formera id="X"] to display your survey (replace X with your survey ID)
sections.faq:
How do I create a survey?

Navigate to Formera > All Surveys in your WordPress admin, then click “Add New Survey”. Use the intuitive builder to add questions and customize your survey.

How do I display a survey on my site?

Use the shortcode [formera id="X"] where X is your survey ID. You can find the ID in the surveys list.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, Formera includes GDPR mode which can be enabled in the settings.
